checks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),os=require('os');const {OPEN}=require('./scripts/extract-live-body');const D='smoke/fixtures/csp-lesson-bodies';const t=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'csplesson-'));for(const f of fs.readdirSync(D))if(f.endsWith('.html'))fs.writeFileSync(path.join(t,f),''+OPEN+fs.readFileSync(path.join(D,f),'utf8')+String.fromCharCode(10)+' ');console.log(t);" > /tmp/csplessondir.txt && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {build}=require('./scripts/csp-lesson-exercise-links');const v=new Set(fs.readFileSync('smoke/fixtures/live-page-handles.txt','utf8').split(String.fromCharCode(10)).map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean));const r=build(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/csplessondir.txt','utf8').trim(),v);if(r.problems.length)throw new Error(r.problems[0]);if(r.pages.length!==35)throw new Error('built '+r.pages.length);const same=r.pages.filter(p=>p.body===p.original);const applied=r.pages.filter(p=>p.applied);const other=r.pages.filter(p=>p.body!==p.original&&!p.applied);if(same.length!==14)throw new Error('expected 14 byte-identical rebuilds, got '+same.length);if(applied.length!==18)throw new Error('expected 18 applied cards, got '+applied.length);if(other.length!==3)throw new Error('expected 3 subtitle corrections, got '+other.length);console.log('REBUILD FAITHFUL '+same.length+' byte-identical, '+applied.length+' gain the graded card, '+other.length+' correct a subtitle that says not graded on a graded page');"
checks._why: The generator is run against the 35 CSP lesson bodies exactly as the storefront serves them. 14 come back byte for byte identical to what is published, which is a stronger statement about the rebuild than any synthetic fixture could make: it reproduces real live bodies exactly. The 21 that differ are accounted for one by one, 18 gaining the graded card and 3 correcting a subtitle that currently tells a student their work is not graded.
